candidate_windows.window_text: The main limitations of this work include: (1) We require large-scale pretrained models. The generation performance is strongly dependent on the size of models. We use 4 RTX-A6000 GPUs for running the T5-XXL model. (2) Due to the lack of large-sized PLMs, the quantity and quality of this generated Chinese CKG still fall behind similar English resources. (3) We still cannot interpret the behavior of large PLMs. The specific source of the generated commonsense knowledge is hard to locate, and there are potential ethical risks since the results are not completely checked. (4) We still require extra human labor when applying the method to each new language. Although basically our methods and underlying models (mT5) can generalize for other languages, we still need human-crafted prompts and a minor size of annotations for training filter models.
